measurement_design.no_comparison_sentence: This cell makes no comparison: it is an ASSET. SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-ROLL-3-DEV2000-ADDED-S.note: The four-row structural form smoke of ROLL-3 proves FORM and nothing else: five custodied Solver samples per row, the plurality-commit replay, zero native task-contract calls, every request fitting. It is scored by no one and read by no one, and under docs/readiness/2026-09-26-slurp-stage3-measurement-instrument-v1.md section 3 rule 5 a batch of four rows can never be evidence of benefit.

SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-ROLL-3-DEV2000-ADDED-V.note: ROLL-3 makes no effectiveness claim of its own: it seals a 1,000-row x 5-sample pool on DEV-2000-ADDED so that commit, selection and verification rules can be read offline at about the 0.67 pp floor of docs/readiness/2026-09-26-slurp-stage3-measurement-instrument-v1.md section 2c (about 0.53 pp at n = 1,000), on the evaluation roster where every admitted policy must later be replicated. Any benefit claim belongs to the read over this pool, which declares its own block; that read reports intent accuracy beside SLU-F1 (owner decisions 133 and 137).

measurement_design.why_offline_sealed_pool: The measurement instrument note docs/readiness/2026-09-26-slurp-stage3-measurement-instrument-v1.md establishes that a cross-flight contrast at this scale carries a measured +1.87 pp A/A offset (two request-identical flights differed by +1.87 pp SLU with a CI95 excluding zero while intent moved -1.28 pp; on this very roster the B6 pair measured -0.25 pp), so such a contrast needs an in-chain A/A replicate and about 3 pp of effect. The only sub-1 pp instrument the program has is an offline read over one sealed sample pool, and that pool exists on R01C and TRAIN Fold A but NOT on DEV-2000-ADDED. This cell creates the missing pool.

files: per_row.json -- one object per row: sample_id, utterance_id, each of the five samples' official SLU-F1 and scenario_action_exact, the per-row best / worst / delivered scores and the sample-level raw-response digests. Ids, sample indices, scores, flags and hashes only (this roster withholds the stratum per item).

spread.json -- the within-flight sample spread on DEV-2000-ADDED: the pooled paired delta between sample indices with CI95 by bootstrap over the utterance id (10,000 draws, seed 20260915; 87 utterances carry two recordings, owner decision 79 D2), the byte-identical / intent-flip / entity-set-flip shares and the per-channel (headset / far-field) table.
ceiling.json -- the oracle best-of-5 ceiling on DEV-2000-ADDED beside the delivered score, stated as an UPPER BOUND that no selection policy can exceed, never as an achieved result.
the per-sample-index outputs copies and their score jsonl, sha256-pinned, written by scripts/analysis/stage3_rollout_score.py under the read's own analysis root.
output.privacy: No utterance text, gold label, transcript or model output is printed or persisted by the read's summary files; they carry ids, sample indices, scores, flags and hashes only.

roster.stratum_coverage: 13 of 18 SLURP scenarios in the devel mixture (the stratum is withheld per item by the receipt); 913 distinct utterances, 87 with two recordings.

row_accounting_required: 1,000 in, 1,000 out; every row's solver_group carries exactly 5 samples in custody (I7g) with seeds 1249110493, 1249110494, 1249110495, 1249110496, 1249110497 and temperature 0.7 on each; the commit replay of saea-commit-plurality-support-v1 at min_support 3 / similarity 0.8 reproduces the sealed delivered answer for every row; zero native task-contract calls.

stages.1_render: scripts/analysis/stage3_rollout_score.py --stage render: one outputs COPY per Solver sample index (0..4), each row's solver_group.samples[index].parsed_answer rendered through the canonical analysis path, exactly as cells ROLL-1 and ROLL-2 are read.
stages.2_score: scripts/analysis/stage3_rollout_score.py --stage score --scorer-id slurp-slu-official-projected-v3: each of the five copies scored ONCE through the registered scorer against DEVEL gold (the -train sibling cells ROLL-1 and ROLL-2 use resolves TRAIN gold and refuses a devel prediction). Never core.scoring_batch (every copy is a derived read, not a manifest score).
stages.3_pairs: scripts/analysis/stage3_rollout_score.py --stage pairs: per-row best / worst and the sealed delivered score, as for cells ROLL-1 and ROLL-2. This is where the oracle best-of-5 ceiling on DEV-2000-ADDED comes from.
stages.4_spread: the within-flight spread read: per row and per sample-index pair, delta_slu and delta_intent, the pooled distributions with CI95 by bootstrap over the utterance id (10,000 draws, seed 20260915), the three flip shares and the per-channel table. REGISTERED SEPARATELY as run id SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-ROLL-3-DEV2000-ADDED-READ-V1 before any number is read.
